description:
Add wallets to a drop's recipient list (push drops, or an allowlist). Pass wallets, or csv text with one wallet per line.

Params: store_id, drop_id, wallets?, csv?, session_token?, idempotency_key?
Returns: {ok, idempotency_key, added: number, invalid: string[]}
Errors: INVALID_PARAMS, NO_CREDENTIALS, IAP_PLAN_REQUIRED, HTTP_404

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency-Key for this write. Omit to generate one; reuse the returned idempotency_key to retry safely

session_token.description: Session token from authenticate. Optional when CHAINDADDY_API_KEY is set (or, for store-scoped tools, CHAINDADDY_IAP_KEY)

name: iap_add_drop_recipients
title: Add drop recipients
